# BIKLAW

> Los Angeles-based law firm specializing in medical malpractice, personal injury, and business litigation led by Bradley I. Kramer, M.D., Esq.

BIKLAW is a full-service law firm in Los Angeles offering comprehensive legal representation across personal injury claims (automobile, bicycle, motorcycle, pedestrian accidents), medical malpractice cases, and business litigation. The firm is led by Bradley I. Kramer, who uniquely combines medical and legal expertise to serve clients in complex injury and litigation matters.
